18833-with-clive-in-india-or-the-beginni.title: Or, The Beginnings of an Empire
18833-with-clive-in-india-or-the-beginni.creator: G. A. Henty
18833-with-clive-in-india-or-the-beginni.description: A book by G. A. Henty. "Life of Lord Clive," recently published by Lieutenant Colonel Malleson, and to other standard authorities. In this book I have devoted a somewhat smaller space to the personal adventures of my hero than in my other historical tales, but the events themselves were of such a thrilling and exciting nature that no fiction could surpass them.

74727-history-of-the-world-war-volume-2-.title: History Of The World War Volume 2 Of 7
74727-history-of-the-world-war-volume-2-.creator: Unknown
74727-history-of-the-world-war-volume-2-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. German and British Squadrons Grapple off the Chilean   Coast--Germany Wins the First Round--England Comes Back with   Terrific Force--Graphic Picture of the Destruction of the   German Squadron off Falkland Islands--English Coast Towns   Bombarded for the First Time in Many Years 114

9398-gloria-and-treeless-street.title: Gloria And Treeless Street
9398-gloria-and-treeless-street.creator: Annie Hamilton Donnell
9398-gloria-and-treeless-street.description: A book by Annie Hamilton Donnell. It was only Gloria who called him Uncle Em. He was not really uncle anyway to Gloria, being merely her kind, good-natured, easily-coaxed guardian. But for ten years he and this sweet-faced elderly woman in the doorway had been father and mother to the orphaned girl.

arxiv-1705-00571.title: Lancaster A at SemEval-2017 Task 5: Evaluation metrics matter: predicting sentiment from financial news headlines
arxiv-1705-00571.creator: Andrew Moore, Paul Rayson
arxiv-1705-00571.description: Abstract This paper describes our participation in Task 5 track 2 of SemEval 2017 to predict the sentiment of financial news headlines for a specific company on a continuous scale between -1 and 1. We tackled the problem using a number of approaches, utilising a Support Vector Regression (SVR) and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BLSTM).

arxiv-2202-12258.title: A Method for Waste Segregation using Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2202-12258.creator: Jash Shah, Sagar Kamat
arxiv-2202-12258.description: Abstract Segregation of garbage is a primary concern in many nations across the world. Even though we are in the modern era, many people still do not know how to distinguish between organic and recyclable waste. It is because of this that the world is facing a major crisis of waste disposal.

arxiv-2204-03452.title: Physics is organized around transformations connecting contextures in a polycontextural world Journal: Foundations of Science
arxiv-2204-03452.creator: Johannes Falk, Edwin Eichler, Katja Windt, Marc-Thorsten Hütt
arxiv-2204-03452.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Johannes Falk, Edwin Eichler, Katja Windt, Marc-Thorsten Hütt. The rich body of physical theories defines the foundation of our understanding of the world. Its mathematical formulation is based on classical Aristotelian (binary) logic. In the philosophy of science the ambiguities, paradoxes, and the possibility of subjective interpretations of facts have challenged binary logic, leading, among other developments, to Gotthard Günther’s theory of polycontexturality (often also termed ’transclassical logic’).

arxiv-2204-06734.title: The Forms of Categorical Proposition
arxiv-2204-06734.creator: Fabien Schang, George Englebretsen, J.-Martín Castro-Manzano
arxiv-2204-06734.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Fabien Schang, George Englebretsen, J.-Martín Castro-Manzano. An exhaustive survey of categorical propositions is proposed in the present paper, both with respect to their nature and the logical problems raised by them. Through a comparative analysis of Term Logic and First-Order Logic, it is shown that the famous problem of existential import may be solved in two ways: with a model-adaptive strategy, in which the square of opposition is validated by restricting the models; with a language-adaptive strategy, in which the logical form of categorical

arxiv-2206-06505.title: Mass and Expansion of Asymptotically Conical Kähler Metrics
arxiv-2206-06505.creator: Qi Yao
arxiv-2206-06505.description: Abstract . We prove an expansion theorem on scalar-flat asymptotically conical (AC) Kähler metrics. The ADM mass is known to be defined in ALE Riemannian manifolds. The concept of ADM mass can be generalized to AC cases. Consider an AC Kähler manifold with asymptotic to a Ricci-flat Kähler metric cone with complex dimension n n .

arxiv-2206-09711.title: Kolmogorov algorithm for isochronous Hamiltonian systems
arxiv-2206-09711.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . We present a Kolmogorov-like algorithm for the computation of a normal form in the neighborhood of an invariant torus in ‘isochronous’ Hamiltonian systems, i.e., systems with Hamiltonians of the form ℋ = ℋ 0 + ε ​ ℋ 1 \mathcal{H}=\mathcal{H}_{0}+\varepsilon\mathcal{H}_{1} where ℋ 0 \mathcal{H}_{0} is the Hamiltonian of N N linear oscillators, and ℋ 1 \mathcal{H}_{1} is expandable as a polynomial series in the oscillators’ canonical variables.

arxiv-2211-04503.title: The Impact of Cosmic Ray Injection on Magnetic Flux Tubes in a Galactic Disk Journal: The Astrophysical Journal Athena++ ( Stone et al. 2020 ; Jiang & Oh 2018 ) , MatPlotLib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ; Harris et al. 2020 ) , AstroPy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astr
arxiv-2211-04503.creator: Roark Habegger, Ellen G. Zweibel, Sherry Wong
arxiv-2211-04503.description: Abstract In a seminal paper, Parker (1966) showed the vertical stratification of the interstellar medium (ISM) is unstable if magnetic fields and cosmic rays provide too large a fraction of pressure support. Cosmic ray acceleration is linked to star formation, so Parker’s Instability and its nonlinear outcomes are a type of star formation feedback.

arxiv-2212-05301.title: Leveraging Modality-specific Representations for Audio-visual Speech Recognition via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2212-05301.creator: Chen Chen, Yuchen Hu, Qiang Zhang, Heqing Zou, Beier Zhu, Eng Siong Chng
arxiv-2212-05301.description: Abstract Audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) has gained remarkable success for ameliorating the noise-robustness of speech recognition. Mainstream methods focus on fusing audio and visual inputs to obtain modality-invariant representations. However, such representations are prone to over-reliance on audio modality as it is much easier to recognize than video modality in clean conditions.

arxiv-2305-06275.title: Unpacking merger jets: a Bayesian analysis of GW170817, GW190425 and electromagnetic observations of short gamma-ray bursts
arxiv-2305-06275.creator: Fergus Hayes, Ik Siong Heng, Gavin Lamb, En-Tzu Lin, John Veitch, Michael J. Williams
arxiv-2305-06275.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fergus Hayes, Ik Siong Heng, Gavin Lamb, En-Tzu Lin, John Veitch, Michael J. Williams. We present a novel fully Bayesian analysis to constrain short gamma-ray burst jet structures associated with cocoon, wide-angle and simple top-hat jet models, as well as the binary neutron star merger rate.

arxiv-2407-08988.title: FEM on nonuniform meshes for nonlocal Laplacian: Semi-analytic Implementation in One Dimension Thanks: 1 College of Computer Science and Mathematics, Central South University of Forestry and Technology, Changsha, Hunan, 410004, China. The research of the author is partially supported by the Natural
arxiv-2407-08988.creator: Hongbin Chen 1 , Changtao Sheng 2 and Li-Lian Wang 3
arxiv-2407-08988.description: Abstract . In this paper, we compute stiffness matrix of the nonlocal Laplacian discretized by the piecewise linear finite element on nonuniform meshes, and implement the FEM in the Fourier transformed domain. We derive useful integral expressions of the entries that allow us to explicitly or semi-analytically evaluate the entries for various interaction kernels.

arxiv-2412-21059.title: VisionReward: Fine-Grained Multi-Dimensional Human Preference Learning for Image and Video Generation
arxiv-2412-21059.creator: Jiazheng Xu, Yu Huang, Jiale Cheng, Yuanming Yang, Jiajun Xu, Yuan Wang, Wenbo Duan, Shen Yang, Qunlin Jin, Shurun Li, Jiayan Teng, Zhuoyi Yang, Wendi Zheng, Xiao Liu, Dan Zhang, Ming Ding, Xiaohan Zhang, Shiyu Huang, Xiaotao Gu, Minlie Huang, Jie Tang, Yuxiao Dong
arxiv-2412-21059.description: Abstract Visual generative models have achieved remarkable progress in synthesizing photorealistic images and videos, yet aligning their outputs with human preferences across critical dimensions remains a persistent challenge. Though reinforcement learning from human feedback offers promise for preference alignment, existing reward models for visual generation face limitations, including black-box scoring without interpretability and potentially resultant unexpected biases.

arxiv-2504-01949.title: Comparison of Bayesian methods for extrapolation of treatment effects: a large scale simulation study
arxiv-2504-01949.creator: Tristan Fauvel, Julien Tanniou, Pascal Godbillot, Marie Génin, Billy Amzal
arxiv-2504-01949.description: Abstract Extrapolating treatment effects from related studies is a promising strategy for designing and analyzing clinical trials in situations where achieving an adequate sample size is challenging. Bayesian methods are well-suited for this purpose, as they enable the synthesis of prior information through the use of prior distributions.

arxiv-2509-14995.title: On the Late-Time Instability of MOT solution to the Time-Domain PMCHWT Equation
arxiv-2509-14995.creator: Van Chien Le, Viviana Giunzioni, Pierrick Cordel, Francesco P. Andriulli, and Kristof Cools
arxiv-2509-14995.description: Abstract This paper investigates the late-time instability of marching-on-in-time solution to the time-domain PMCHWT equation. The stability analysis identifies the static solenoidal nullspace of the time-domain electric field integral operator as the primary cause of instability. Furthermore, it reveals that the instability mechanisms of the time-domain PMCHWT equation are fundamentally different from those of the time-domain electric field integral equation.

arxiv-2511-10974.title: Preserving Cross-Modal Consistency for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
arxiv-2511-10974.creator: Haoran Chen Houze Xu Micah Goldblum Daoguo Dong Zuxuan Wu
arxiv-2511-10974.description: Abstract Class-incremental learning (CIL) enables models to continuously learn new categories from sequential tasks without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. While recent advances in vision–language models such as CLIP have demonstrated strong generalization across domains, extending them to continual settings remains challenging.

arxiv-2511-15612.title: Cartan meets Cramér-Rao
arxiv-2511-15612.creator: Sunder Ram Krishnan*
arxiv-2511-15612.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sunder Ram Krishnan*. This paper develops a jet bundle and Cartan geometric foundation for the curvature-aware refinements of the Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) introduced in our earlier work. We show that the extrinsic corrections to variance bounds, previously derived from the second fundamental form of the square root embedding s θ = f ⁡ ( ⋅ , θ ) ∈ L 2 ​ ( μ ) s_{\theta}=\sqrt{f(\cdot;\theta)}\in L^{2}(\mu) for model density f ⁡ ( ⋅ , θ ) f(\cdot;\theta) with scalar parameter θ \theta ,

arxiv-2511-20678.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Cryptocurrency Portfolio Management Using Soft Actor–Critic and Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient Algorithms
arxiv-2511-20678.creator: Kamal Paykan
arxiv-2511-20678.description: Abstract . This study proposes a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for dynamic cryptocurrency portfolio management across four major assets: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Dogecoin. The trading environment is formulated as a discrete-time stochastic system in which an intelligent agent optimizes portfolio allocation through interaction with market data.

arxiv-2601-21219.title: Soft Quantization: Model Compression Via Weight Coupling
arxiv-2601-21219.creator: Daniel T. Bernstein, Luca Di Carlo, David Schwab
arxiv-2601-21219.description: Abstract We show that introducing short-range attractive couplings between the weights of a neural network during training provides a novel avenue for model quantization. These couplings rapidly induce the discretization of a model’s weight distribution, and they do so in a mixed-precision manner despite only relying on two additional hyperparameters.

arxiv-2603-18406.title: QCD and electroweak phase transitions with hidden scale invariance: implications for primordial black holes, quark-lepton nuggets and gravitational waves.

pmc-10672935.title: Research on Surface Integrity and Fatigue Properties in the Turning of TC17 Titanium Alloy Based on the Response Surface Method
pmc-10672935.creator: Xunqing Lai, Yuannan Wang, Dan Wang, Guolong Zhao, Yinfei Yang, Szymon Wojciechowski, Daniela Kovacheva, Francesco Iacoviello
pmc-10672935.description: Titanium alloy parts are more and more widely used in the field of aerospace. In order to improve the service life of titanium alloy parts, the response surface method was used to study surface residual stress and roughness under different turning parameters.

pmc-10748205.title: Virus–Host Protein Interaction Network of the Hepatitis E Virus ORF2-4 by Mammalian Two-Hybrid Assays
pmc-10748205.creator: Laura Corneillie, Irma Lemmens, Karin Weening, Amse De Meyer, Freya Van Houtte, Jan Tavernier, Philip Meuleman, Hiroaki Okamoto
pmc-10748205.description: Throughout their life cycle, viruses interact with cellular host factors, thereby influencing propagation, host range, cell tropism and pathogenesis. The hepatitis E virus (HEV) is an underestimated RNA virus in which knowledge of the virus–host interaction network to date is limited. Here, two related high-throughput mammalian two-hybrid approaches (MAPPIT and KISS) were used to screen for HEV-interacting host proteins.

pmc-11455319.title: 7958 Organ Of Zuckerkandl Paragangliomas
pmc-11455319.creator: Lyle McVicker, Suzanne Marie Egan, Kevin C Conlon, James Gibney, John Feeney, Maria Whelan, Aoife Garrahy
pmc-11455319.description: Disclosure: L. McVicker: None. S. Egan: None. K.C. Conlon: None. J. Gibney: None. J. Feeney: None. M. Whelan: None. A. Garrahy: None. Background: The Organ of Zuckerkandl (OoZ) was first described in 1901 by an Austrian anatomist Emile Zuckerkandl as a para-aortic paraganglia located laterally to the abdominal aorta at the level of the inferior mesenteric artery.

pmc-11656114.title: Investigating the Norwegian eHealth Governance Model: Document Study
pmc-11656114.creator: Line Helen Linstad, Hilde Bjørnå, Anne Moen, Truls Tunby Kristiansen, Anne Helen Hansen, Amaryllis Mavragani, Angely Garcia, Jean-Frederic Menard
pmc-11656114.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundGovernments and policy makers struggle to achieve a balance between hierarchical steering and horizontal governance in systems characterized by fragmented decision authority and multiple interests. To realize its One Citizen–One Journal eHealth policy vision, the Norwegian government established a special eHealth board of stakeholders to create an inclusive governance model that aligned stakeholders’ interests with the government’s ambitions through coordination and consensus.

pmc-12393733.title: Machine learning-based identification of diagnostic and prognostic mitotic cell cycle genes in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12393733.creator: Ceren Sucularli
pmc-12393733.description: Mitotic cell cycle (MCC) is a critical process in cell growth and division, and dysregulation of MCC genes may contribute to tumorigenesis. In this study, to identify diagnostic and prognostic value of MCC genes, differentially expressed MCC genes between HCC and normal tissues were identified and subjected to machine learning methods.

pmc-12542302.title: Calcium dissociation with carbonate ions from Pf‐SCP, sarcoplasmic calcium‐binding protein in Pinctada fucata, contributes to calcium mineralization for shell formation
pmc-12542302.creator: Yuto Namikawa, Lingxiao Zhu, Peng Lu, Koji Nagata, Michio Suzuki
pmc-12542302.description: Pf‐SCP is an EF‐hand protein identified in Pinctada fucata that is responsible for calcium transport and concentration in the mantle for shell formation. Previous studies have reported the calcium‐binding properties of the EF‐hand domains and the localization of Pf‐SCP. To understand the calcification from Pf‐SCP as a source of calcium, the dissociation of calcium from Pf‐SCP must be investigated.

pmc-12638834.title: Reconciling time and prediction error theories of associative learning
pmc-12638834.creator: Noé Hamou, Samuel J. Gershman, Gautam Reddy
pmc-12638834.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Learning involves forming associations between sensory events that have a consistent temporal relationship. Influential theories based on prediction errors explain numerous behavioral and neurobiological observations but do not account for how animals measure the passage of time. Here, we propose a theory for temporal causal learning, where the structure of inter-stimulus intervals is used to infer the singular cause of a rewarding stimulus.

pmc-13324158.title: Physiological shear flow enhances pinocytosis in human platelets
pmc-13324158.creator: Masataka Inoue, Kasumi Sagawa, Nobuo Watanabe
pmc-13324158.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Pinocytosis, the uptake of extracellular fluid, is an important yet poorly understood function of platelets. Although platelets are continuously exposed to shear flow in the circulation, the mechanism by which shear modulates pinocytosis in human platelets remains unclear. Here, we investigated the effects of physiological shear rate on platelet pinocytosis using a rotational viscometer combined with flow cytometric quantification using pHrodo dextran. Exposure to 500–1500 s-1 shear rates enhanced platelet pinocytosis and increased intracellular Ca2+ levels measured using Fluo-4.

pmc-13378447.title: Marked Response to Immunochemotherapy in Airway Mucosal Recurrence of Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13378447.creator: Zijian Li, Chudong Wang, YenZhir Tay, Shuben Li
pmc-13378447.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objectives: Airway mucosal recurrence after complete resection of primary lung cancer is rare and lacks standard treatment. We aim to report a marked response to immunochemotherapy in a patient with multifocal airway mucosal recurrence of lung squamous cell carcinoma. Case description: A 50-year-old male patient presented with an irritative cough 2 years after right upper sleeve lobectomy for lung squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) (pT1bN0M0). Computed tomography and bronchoscopy revealed multiple recurrent polypoidal lesions in the trachea, with biopsy confirming recurrent SCC.

pmc-13547050.title: Effect of perioperative multistrain probiotics on the CT callus volume fraction at 12 weeks after surgery for closed tibial shaft fracture: a single-center randomized controlled study
pmc-13547050.creator: Yongbiao Huang, Xuqiang Zheng, Chengjun Liao, Gang Liu, Mingliang Li
pmc-13547050.description: BackgroundConventional radiographs lack sensitivity for early healing, whereas computed tomography (CT)–derived bone volume fraction (BV/TV) allows quantitative assessment of callus mineralization. Perioperative antibiotics and surgical stress disrupt gut microbiota, potentially impairing fracture healing. Multistrain probiotics may enhance bone repair via immunomodulation and the gut–bone axis.
